name: f4-s607
prompt: <image1> shows a creature. Draw the same creature at its next, more grown-up stage. The whole silhouette changes: it stands up: the whole body is now vertical and taller than wide, rearing up tall on its tail in a playful upright S-curve like an otter standing on its hind legs, with a clear slender neck; the head becomes much smaller in relation to the body; the front legs become small paddle flippers held in front of the chest; the tail curls on the ground behind it. Keep the face, the coral cheeks, the three soft coral gill fronds on each side of the head, the cream belly stripe from chin to tail tip and the flat style without outlines; the body is light warm apricot (#FFC56E), not orange. Fins and wings are coral, never turquoise or green. No teeth, no claws. Full body, plain flat pale mint background.
